china_race_dynamics.text: Safeguarding organizations from cybersecurity risks involving AI requires collaboration and innovation from both the private and public sector. This commonsense legislation creates a voluntary database for reporting AI security and safety incidents and promotes best practices to mitigate AI risks. Additionally, this bill would establish a new Artificial Intelligence Security Center, within the NSA, tasked with promoting secure AI adoption as we continue to innovate and embrace new AI technologies.
